summary: Reproduced that AnthropicMessagesRequest silently discarded PD bootstrap and DP-routing metadata, then added the matching fields and forwarded them unchanged into ChatCompletionRequest. Added scalar regression coverage plus independent list-valued and omitted-field boundary cases.

tests.what_was_measured: On the untouched base, bootstrap_host, bootstrap_port, bootstrap_room, routed_dp_rank, and disagg_prefill_dp_rank were absent after AnthropicMessagesRequest validation; the assertion on bootstrap_room failed. Raw output: reports/j-2476198ea9fa/raw/failing-before.txt

Three focused conversion tests passed: scalar PD/DP fields are preserved, list-valued bootstrap fields are preserved, and omitted fields remain None. Raw output: reports/j-2476198ea9fa/raw/pytest-pd-routing.txt
The complete Anthropic serving unit suite passed: 64 tests and 5 subtests. Raw output: reports/j-2476198ea9fa/raw/pytest-anthropic-serving.txt
Repository registered-test metadata validation passed. Raw output: reports/j-2476198ea9fa/raw/check-registered-tests.txt
Changed Python source and tests compiled successfully. Raw output: reports/j-2476198ea9fa/raw/compileall.txt
No whitespace errors were found. Raw output: reports/j-2476198ea9fa/raw/git-diff-check.txt

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect is entirely in HTTP request model validation and Anthropic-to-OpenAI request conversion, before engine or GPU execution. No GPU claim is made.

remaining_limitations: The original two-worker Ascend PD serving deployment and ascend transfer backend were not available; a single gfx950 GPU cannot qualify that architecture or distributed path.

No full model serving run was performed because the reproduced loss occurs deterministically before model execution. The tests validate request transport into ChatCompletionRequest, not model semantics or multi-node KV transfer.
